title: Confidence Radius Games for Regression Adjustment with Skewed Potential Outcomes
banked_reason: Supervisor-directed terminal stop of capped D-0.5 proposal: three reviews repeated applicability objections after conditional framing; no in-scope repair remains. Soundness and novelty were not the issue; load-bearing claims remain unproved and no Lean certification occurred.
gap_reasons: Revise the model justification: either supply a credible applied regime for the two load-bearing exact latent restrictions, or explicitly reposition the work as a conditional mathematical decision-theory benchmark before advancing to Stage 0.
proof_attempt_summary: Three D-0.5 reviews repeated applicability objections after whole-proposal conditional framing and retagging. The supervisor directed a capped-proposal terminal stop because no in-scope repair remains; soundness and novelty were not the issue. Stable-selector/contact, global-certificate, transfer and skewed-family obligations remain unproved; no D0/F-stage or Lean certification occurred.
tldr: Conditional confidence-decision theory is studied for the exact latent \(q_N=0\), locally opposite-loading fixed-table subexperiment under balanced complete randomization. This deliberately singular zero-coordinate slice of the wider regression-adjustment setting retains error at scale \(N^{-1}\) and arbitrary admissible skewed third moments. The kernel requires evaluation of both prescribed-center all-Borel radius games, pure attaining rules, certified global continuum values, and transfer of one moment-indexed optimal policy to assigned records. Stable intrinsic quantile selection through covariance contacts, branch ties and zero-approaching nuisance, together with a substantive evaluated legal skewed family, remains to prove. Conditional-normal reduction, intrinsic implementation and the occupied diagonal solution are support. The centered-defect tangent lemma quantifies only within-slice sensitivity at RMS \(o(N^{-1/2})\); its policy conclusions depend on the unresolved optimal-envelope transfer. Assigned records do not validate either the latent equal-second-moment restriction or the cross-world opposite-loading relation. No general regression-adjustment applicability or off-slice inference is claimed.
gap: For the exact latent \(q_N=0\), locally opposite-loading fixed-table subexperiment, normal-mean uncertain-prior intervals and generic confidence duality do not settle the prescribed-center product/noisy-score confidence game or its common-policy transfer. Normal-location score adaptation itself is credited prior work. This is a conditional confidence-decision gap, not a general regression-adjustment inference gap.
fill: The conditional contribution requires certified global primal/dual values, pure attainment, stable intrinsic quantile selection across covariance contacts and branch ties including zero-approaching nuisance, total assigned-record transfer, and evaluation on a legal open skewed family. The Farchione--Kabaila five-axis non-equivalence map delimits the confidence contracts. The project-specific defect normalization and tangent sensitivity lemma preserve the same exact-slice target; they supply neither exact optimizer contacts, selector stability nor restricted sharpness. The complete structural kernel, rather than a tangent lemma or feasible gain certificate, determines the attainable tier.
